SELECT T1.code_module FROM assessments AS T1 JOIN studentAssessment AS T2 ON T1.id_assessment = T2.id_assessment WHERE T1.assessment_type = 'CMA' AND T2.score IS NOT NULL GROUP BY T1.code_module HAVING AVG(T2.score) > (SELECT AVG(T4.score) FROM assessments AS T3 JOIN studentAssessment AS T4 ON T3.id_assessment = T4.id_assessment WHERE T3.assessment_type = 'TMA' AND T3.code_module = T1.code_module AND T4.score IS NOT NULL)
